seoTitle: How to Change Your Name on eBay
metaDescription: Update your first or last name on eBay, fix a typo, or edit personalization numbers on both the desktop site and mobile app with this simple guide.
intro: Whether you need to correct a typo, update your legal name, or adjust personalization details, changing your name on eBay is handled through your account's Personal info page rather than a dedicated "edit profile" screen. This guide walks through getting there from the top-right account menu, what the Personal info section actually contains, and an important catch for anyone whose eBay account is linked to a Payoneer payment account — since in that case, the fix isn't always made on eBay directly.

steps.heading: Open the account dropdown
steps.body: From any eBay page while signed in, click your account name in the top-left corner next to "Hi [name]" to open the dropdown menu. It shows your account name and username, followed by two links: Account settings and Sign out. Account settings is the door into everything covered in this guide, including where your name and personal details live.

image.caption: The account dropdown, opened from the top-left corner, showing Account settings and Sign out as the two available links.

steps.heading: Navigate to Personal info under My eBay
steps.body: Account settings takes you into My eBay's Account tab, with a left-hand menu split into Personal information and privacy, Payment information, Account preferences, Selling, and Donation preferences. Click Personal information, then Personal info, to land on the page showing your Username, Account type, and Contact details — email address and phone number, each with an Edit link next to it.

image.caption: The Personal info page under My eBay's Account tab, listing Username, Account type, and Contact details with Edit links for each field.

steps.heading: Edit the field that actually needs changing
steps.body: Your eBay username and your legal name are different things — the username is what buyers see attached to reviews and listings, while your legal name is used for verification, invoicing, and payouts. If you're correcting a typo in the name buyers see, the Username Edit link on this page is the one to use. If it's your legal name tied to payment and verification that needs updating, that lives in a separate section further down Personal info, since eBay treats identity verification data more cautiously than a display username.

steps.heading: Watch for the Payoneer notice on payment-linked accounts
steps.body: If your eBay account is connected to a Payoneer account for receiving payouts, the Personal info page displays a blue notice explaining that changes to certain details need to be made on Payoneer's side instead, and that updates made there typically sync to eBay within 24 hours. This is easy to miss and explains why some users report their name change "not saving" on eBay — the edit may need to happen in Payoneer first rather than directly in eBay's own settings.

steps.heading: Check business vs. personal account differences
steps.body: The Account type field on the Personal info page shows whether you're registered as Individual or Business. Business accounts typically display a company name rather than a personal first and last name, and changing it usually requires updating your registered business details rather than a simple name field — worth confirming your account type here before assuming the edit process is the same as a personal account.

steps.heading: Repeat the process on the mobile app if that's easier
steps.body: The same Personal info section is reachable from the eBay app: tap your profile icon, then Account, then Personal information, and you'll find the same Username and Contact details layout as on desktop. If you started the change on one platform and it doesn't appear to have saved, check the other — sometimes the sync between web and app, or between eBay and Payoneer, takes a few minutes to catch up.

faq.question: Will buyers see my updated name immediately?
faq.answer: Username changes typically apply right away, but if your account syncs identity details from Payoneer, allow up to 24 hours for the change to fully reflect.

faq.question: Are there limits to how often I can change my name on eBay?
faq.answer: Yes, eBay limits how frequently you can edit your username and account details, so make sure the change is accurate before saving.

faq.question: Can I change my name from the eBay app instead of desktop?
faq.answer: Yes, the same Personal info section under Account is available in the eBay mobile app with the same edit options.

faq.question: Why isn't my name change saving on eBay?
faq.answer: If your account is linked to Payoneer for payouts, some detail changes need to be made on the Payoneer account instead — eBay's Personal info page displays a notice about this directly.

faq.question: Does changing my name affect my seller or buyer history?
faq.answer: No, updating your name or username doesn't erase or affect your existing transaction history on eBay.
